name: Domino Affiliate – Advanced Affiliate Program Kit & Partner Portal for WooCommerce
author: Dominopress

sections.description:
Domino Affiliate empowers store owners to build, scale, and manage a high-performance partner program without the bloat. Engineered specifically for WooCommerce, this plugin combines a robust custom database architecture, an intelligent fraud-defense tracking engine, and visually stunning React applications for both the store owner and the affiliate partner.

🌟 Solving Your Marketing Headaches

Struggling with manual onboarding, complex configurations, and disconnected user experiences? Domino Affiliate solves these core marketing bottlenecks by fully automating the affiliate lifecycle:
* Zero-Touch Onboarding: When candidates apply via your custom popup form, the system automatically creates their WordPress user account, secures their password, and assigns the Affiliate role instantly.
* Seamless Integration: Once approved, the affiliate system natively injects an “Affiliate” tab directly into the default WooCommerce “My Account” page. Your partners never have to navigate clunky, separated backends—they just log in to WooCommerce and access their portal seamlessly!
* Automated Communications: The moment you click “Approve” on an application, the plugin automatically dispatches a branded Welcome Email delivering their Portal URL, assigned Promo Coupons, and login details.

🌟 Key Features

  • Intelligent Tracking Engine: Multi-layered attribution using URLs (?ref=slug), adjustable cookie lifespans, direct whitelisted domains, and IP fallback.
  • Active Fraud Shield: Automatically intercepts and penalizes self-referrals and rapid bot click floods, ensuring your store profit margins are protected.
  • WooCommerce Native Integrations: Hooks directly into WooCommerce checkout to calculate reliable percentage or fixed commissions.
  • Interactive Form Maker: A visual drag-and-drop style form builder to design your customized onboarding applications.
  • Multi-Step Modal Registration: Use the [domino_affiliate_register] shortcode anywhere on your site to render a beautiful, conversion-optimized multi-step modal application form.
  • VIP Commission Tiers: Override default global commission rates with special percentage or flat-fee VIP commissions for top-performing partners.
  • Buyer Discount Coupon Generation: From the admin panel, instantly create WooCommerce discount coupons and assign them to specific affiliates. If a buyer checks out with their coupon, the partner earns the commission automatically!
  • Notification System: The plugin automatically places notification badges (e.g., (2)) directly on your WordPress admin menu sidebar so you instantly know when new affiliates apply.
  • Deep-Dive Analytics Dashboard: Inspect the lifetime conversion funnel for any partner, reviewing traffic, CTRs, and their custom onboarding application responses.
  • Sleek Partner Portal: Affiliate partners get an ultra-clean, restricted portal to track real-time commissions, copy promo coupons, generate QR codes, and download marketing creatives.
  • Manual Distribution Workflows: Complying with zero-live-payment constraints, you can reconcile matured “Pending” commissions and download 1-click CSV formatted ledgers for rapid batch transfers via PayPal or Bank.

🚀 Optimized for Scale

Built on 6 highly optimized custom database tables rather than polluting the WordPress wp_postmeta table. Enjoy sub-millisecond query performance regardless of how many partners or millions of clicks your program processes.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/domino-affiliate-program-manager directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. In your WordPress dashboard sidebar, navigate to Domino Affiliate -> Setup Wizard.
  4. Follow the interactive 5-step wizard to configure your tracking cookies, default commission rates, and automatically publish your Affiliate Registration page.
sections.faq:
Does this process live payouts?

No. For security and compliance, Domino Affiliate acts as an accurate ledger and distribution manager. It aggregates all matured commissions and allows you to generate a CSV export, which you can then upload to PayPal Mass Pay or your bank for one-click fulfillment. You then mark the payout as “Paid” within the plugin.

Will this slow down my store?

Not at all. The plugin utilizes isolated custom database tables for lightning-fast queries and modern React (built via Webpack) for rendering, avoiding bulky PHP page loads.

Can I use custom registration fields?

Yes! Use the Form Maker menu to build out custom screening questionnaires.

  • Initial stable release.
